correctness.rationale: The four exact spectral projection formulas are checked by full rational matrix identities. Universal strict off-diagonal positivity follows from positivity of each of the 40/32/48 coefficients in exact bivariate integer polynomials after clearing a positive common denominator; the provided replay code constructs the polynomials transparently. The diagonal strictly decreases from 1 to -(n-1)/n because R prime has negative numerator -24[(z^2-15)^2+375], proving one exact threshold, and local uniform scaled convergence proves its asymptotic.

value.rationale: The natural matched-link-failure bipartite diffusion network admits an exact sharp maximum positivity-preserving step for sixth-order A-stable integration, all n>=3, with distinctive all-step strict off-diagonal positivity and n^-1 scaling. The result distinguishes A-stability from stochastic positivity and provides an implementable stepsize policy.
